The PR fails its own pytest suite because `matches_tilde` accepts the exclusive upper bound: it uses `<=` instead of `<`. Also, `pick_highest_matching` uses lexical string ordering, which does not select the highest SemVer numerically (for example, `1.2.9` sorts above `1.2.10`).
